answer: Require every agent identity to carry a proof-of-storage pledge. First, the agent commits to holding 500 GB of retrievable data under a unique operator key. Second, the network fires random proof-of-spacetime challenges each epoch, and answers must arrive within minutes. Third, a missed challenge slashes 2,000 locked POA and freezes the identity for a week. To forge 10,000 sybils takes 5 petabytes of real disk answering on time, about $420,000 in drives and bandwidth, and every extra clone feeds the same cost spiral. No amount of pigment paints fake disks into existence.
